description.value: Butterfly World is an indoor tropical garden attraction in Coombs, BC, home to hundreds of free-flying live butterflies along with reptiles, small birds, and other invertebrates. The grounds also include a turtle pond, an outdoor water garden, and an orchid garden, making it a multi-faceted natural-world experience. Coombs sits on a popular Vancouver Island cycling corridor near the famous Old Country Market, so visiting cyclists will find it a natural stop.
